newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds TSB rises as mortgage appeal grows.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds TSB rises as mortgage appeal grows.

text.p: Shares in Lloyds TSB Group Plc put on 4-1/2p to 524p in brisk trade on Friday as the upcoming flotation of a major UK mortgage lender drew attention to the value of its large mortgage book.
The shares are also continuing to benefit from market reaction to a positive trading statement made by the banking group earlier this week.

"The reverberations are still being filtered through the market from the trading statement and the Alliance and Leicester coming to market has stressed the higher valuations of mortgage banks," said one banking analyst.
Lloyds home loan portfolio is 45 billion stg, the second biggest mortgage portfolio of all UK banks. Abbey National has the largest at 64 billion. Abbey shares rose 3-1/2p to 794p.
More than two million Lloyds shares changed hands by 0932 GMT.
